figurative_meaning_en: Reckless or desperate in the face of death
example_sentences_in_bangla: অবস্থা এত খারাপ যে সবাই মরিয়া হয়ে উঠেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The situation is so bad that everyone has become desperate.
note: This idiom conveys a sense of extreme urgency and disregard for personal safety, common in Bengali oral traditions.
